analysis.session_summary: USD and JPY closed as the two clear outperformers, while AUD was weakest and EUR stayed heavy. GBP got a normal positive impulse from its GDP beat but faded against the broad dollar. The yen lifted into the afternoon on suspected intervention, and late Iran/tariff headlines kept risk assets whippy. Most major legs lacked a single clear catalyst; the cleanest reaction was the GBP GDP beat.

themes.evidence: USD/JPY late leg dropped with suspected intervention -29.8 pips in first 15 min; CHF/JPY pullback included -42.7 pips in 15 min.

themes.theme: USD strength despite muted US data
themes.evidence: USD closed at its best, DXY up 0.317% and VIX lower, while US Unemployment Claims moved the basket only -0.003%.

themes.theme: GBP GDP beat but not enough
themes.evidence: UK GDP beat 0.2% vs 0.0% forecast and GBP/USD rose, yet GBP strength pct was -0.113 on the day.

currency_drivers.USD: Closed at highs without a clear US data catalyst while risk appetite firmed.
currency_drivers.EUR: Lacked any euro-specific catalyst and traded heavy against the dollar and Swiss franc.
currency_drivers.JPY: Suspected intervention and official verbal pushback fueled gains with no yen data.
currency_drivers.GBP: A GDP beat provided only brief support before broad USD strength took over.
currency_drivers.AUD: Weakest major with no Australian catalyst as risk aversion hurt commodity currencies.
currency_drivers.CAD: Firmed with no Canadian catalyst despite tariff headlines, closing at its best.
currency_drivers.CHF: Early uptick fully retraced with no Swiss catalyst, closing slightly lower.
currency_drivers.NZD: Soft with no New Zealand catalyst, but held better than AUD.

leg_notes.EUR/USD: EUR/USD posted a series of alternating swings that left it near session lows, with no single catalyst attributable across its legs.

polarity_reads.read: The clean positive GBP reaction to the GDP beat indicates short sterling positioning was not an obstacle and the market is open to UK upside surprises.
The muted dollar reaction despite a 200K vs 194K forecast shows USD strength was not dependent on labor data and longs were already crowded.

scenarios.name: Dollar strength persists into PPI
scenarios.thesis: USD stays bid as equity risk recovers and tariff/Iran headlines keep safe-haven flows, while the yen intervention bid fades.
triggers: US PPI and Core PPI print at or above forecast without a hawkish surprise
scenarios.invalidation: A dovish Lagarde or a weak PPI that hits USD with conviction.

pair_paths.rationale: USD strength continues with no euro catalyst; move could be similar to today's range.
Intervention fades and USD yield support returns; range similar to today's.

scenarios.name: Yen intervention follow-through
scenarios.thesis: Another round of suspected yen buying extends JPY strength across crosses, forcing USD/JPY lower and supporting CHF/JPY downside.
scenarios.invalidation: Japan officials deny or markets ignore the move; USD/JPY recovers above 160.00.

pair_paths.rationale: Yen strength outweighs USD, and USD/JPY has room to the lower end of its range.
Cross-yen intervention momentum pushes CHF/JPY toward the lower end of its wide range.

scenarios.name: European or US data reversal
scenarios.thesis: Lagarde sounds unexpectedly hawkish and US PPI cools, causing EUR short squeeze and USD pullback, with risk pairs repricing.
triggers: Core PPI m/m falls to 0.1% or lower
scenarios.invalidation: US PPI beats and EUR/USD fails above 1.1100.

pair_paths.rationale: A hawkish Lagarde plus weak US PPI squeezes euro shorts within today's range.
If USD weakens and yen intervention fears linger, USD/JPY falls.

risks.risk: Further yen intervention or official jawboning
risks.why_it_matters: Directly drives USD/JPY and cross-yen, could overcome USD strength.
risks.watch: USD/JPY rapid down moves and MoF comments.

risks.why_it_matters: Can strengthen USD and JPY while hurting AUD/NZD and EM FX.
Could validate or puncture current USD bid and adjust Fed expectations.
risks.watch: Core PPI m/m and the initial USD reaction.

analysis.calendar_ahead_note: Coming window includes ECB President Lagarde at 20:30, then US Core PPI and PPI at 14:30; a hawkish Lagarde could give the euro a catalyst, while a PPI surprise will test the muted USD data reaction.
